comment: Hand-written. Implementation status of enumerated resources that differ from their kind's default. Statuses apply to both versions unless a version is named. Traces that place a block are linked to it automatically; packets referenced by the server code default to partial.

block.note: A registry state without rules of its own: represented, stored, sent, imported and exported; solid when it has a collision shape, a redstone conductor as both official servers report, moved, destroyed or left in place by pistons as the official servers do, with no drops; flowing water and lava go into it where both official servers let them (water drops it, lava does not)

item.note: In the item registry with its stack size and durability: stored, moved, thrown and picked up, with no other use

effect.note: Given to players by /effect, combined, counted down and shown with its particle and flags as on both official servers, with its attribute modifiers sent; health boost's, absorption's and jump boost's applied, haste's, conduit power's and mining fatigue's in digging, and those of the effects that heal, hurt or feed (instant health and damage, regeneration, poison, wither, hunger, saturation); given by foods, potions and ominous bottles; absorption ending when used up and the omens' sounds; the effects' other consequences are not modeled yet

cave_air.note: Air with its own state; the rules treat it as air

void_air.note: Air with its own state; the rules treat it as air

slime_block.note: A redstone conductor, as both official servers report

fire.note: Stays on a sturdy top or beside a flammable block, with the faces of its flammable neighbors when nothing below bears or feeds it; ages, burns out, burns its neighbors and spreads in its block ticks, on 1.21.8 only near players unless allowFireTicksAwayFromPlayer, as both official servers do; players in it are hurt and catch fire as both official servers do (client/fire)
deviations: rain and humid biomes do not put it out sooner
hurts and ignites only items, arrows and players

snow.note: Lies on whole collision tops, honey, soul sand, mud and eight layers of snow, not on ice, packed ice or barriers, and breaks without drops when an update finds it unsupported; drops its snowballs for players and explosions by its loot table; sand falling into a single layer replaces it; players stack it up to eight layers and any block they place replaces a single layer, as both official servers do

ice.note: Broken by a player without silk touch, becomes water over a solid block or a liquid, as both official servers do; slippery

frosted_ice.note: Draws its block ticks from the level random and ages and melts in them by its frosted neighbors and the light, and melts when an update from frosted ice leaves it fewer than two frosted neighbors; broken by a player, becomes water like ice, as both official servers do
deviations: frost walker does not make it

soul_fire.note: Stays on soul sand and soul soil only and goes when an update finds it elsewhere, as both official servers do; it neither ages nor spreads
